snippet.title: Food Gang by Bloop Games - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Get the game for free: http://www.bloop-games.com/FoodGang

Food Gang is a fast and explosive multiplayer brawl where crazy food heroes battle with wild weapons.

Game Features:
- Unlock and play 15 crazy heroes, each with their own style, including Bro the gangsta broccoli with an Uzi, Tom the military tomato with a bazooka, Pepe the explosive Mexican chili, and Nori the sushi ninja.
- Fast-paced gameplay full of fights, clashes, shoots, and blasts across six different game modes: Gang Battle (2v2), Food Battle (Free For All), Fast Gang, Fast Food, Last Gang Standing, and Last Food Standing — randomly selected for each battle.
- Unlock 60+ skills to enhance your shoot and blast gameplay in every arena.
- Progress along the trophy road and upgrade your heroes.
- Smooth gameplay with full controller and keyboard support

Food Gang is free-to-play and requires an online connection.
